values.meaning: duration of damage reduction and cleanse
values.quote: For the next 7 seconds, he reduces incoming damage taken.

mechanics.claim: Unbreakable Will cleanses Alistar of all crowd control on cast.
True damage cannot be reduced by Unbreakable Will's damage reduction.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|True damage}} cannot be reduced by any means and will deal full damage to '''Alistar''' during ''Unbreakable Will''.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown begins when the ability is cast, not when its effect ends.
